Notes from the intersection I work on: large new electricity loads such as AI data centers and electrolyzers, and the clean firm power that could serve them. **Briefings** pick a few developments every two weeks and say why they matter for planning and modeling. **Perspectives**, one claim at a time, and a **Data & Tools** guide to the public data and software I use will follow.
